artifacts.name: test_equivalent_csharp_type_spellings_match
artifacts.source_scenario: Equivalent keyword/CLR, qualified BCL, generic, nullable, array, and tuple spellings are compared.

expected.behavior: Every pinned equivalent pair matches without changing its input strings.

artifacts.name: test_distinct_csharp_type_spellings_do_not_match
artifacts.source_scenario: Different primitives, nullability, namespaces, generic arguments, array ranks, tuple positions, and arities are compared.

expected.behavior: Each semantically distinct or syntax-ambiguous pair remains non-equivalent.

artifacts.name: test_unspecified_manifest_type_preserves_runner_semantics
artifacts.source_scenario: Manifest or implementation type values are absent or empty.

expected.behavior: An unspecified manifest type accepts any implementation type; a specified manifest type rejects a missing implementation type.

artifacts.name: test_unsupported_csharp_type_syntax_is_deterministic_and_non_crashing
artifacts.source_scenario: Pointer and function-pointer spellings fall outside the structured canonical subset.

expected.behavior: Canonicalization produces a deterministic conservative form and equal formatting variants match without an exception.

artifacts.name: test_collected_and_snapshot_type_spellings_remain_raw
artifacts.source_scenario: C# source uses fully qualified nested generic types in a public method.

expected.behavior: Arguments and return types retain the exact source spellings even though equivalent aliases compare successfully.

artifacts.name: test_validation_engine_accepts_nested_csharp_alias_equivalence

expected.behavior: End-to-end implementation validation uses the registered C# hook and reports no E302 mismatch.
